title: The Sinclair

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: 52 Church is a retired kitchen space that has turned into the perfect industrial cocktail bar to offer a unique and stylish setting for private events, where raw charm of urban design meets modern elegance. From intimate gatherings to larger celebrations, your guests will feel the upscale but authentic energy in our space. Whether you're planning a cocktail reception, an after-party, or a private celebration, this venue will provide the perfect setting for your guests to relax, mingle, and enjoy.
